Graduating and moving for a new job: a checklist

Put lease dates, work start dates and delivery availability into one plan. Then coordinate your car, belongings and any temporary storage.

Set out the dates first

List move-out, flight, work, move-in and delivery dates. Tell the team where you have flexibility and arrange a destination contact if someone else will receive the shipment.

One inventory, separate shipping needs

List vehicle details separately from boxes and furniture. Ask about suitable methods and do not assume everything will arrive together. Keep a few days of essentials with you.

What if I have not found a home yet?

Ask about storage and later delivery, including fees, access and duration limits, before finalizing your departure plans.

This guide reorganizes public information from the original sites. It is not a live quote or a carrier agreement. Confirm order-specific details with the team and your contract.
